description: Sri Lanka Customs - Customs Rates of Exchange with effect from 11.04.2022 to 17.04.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content involves regulatory matters and compliance requirements for international trade, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
